_meta.title: Proportion of population reporting having personally felt discriminated against or harassed in the previous 12 months (SDG 10.3.1 / 16.b.1)
_meta.series: VC_VOV_GDSD - Proportion of population reporting having felt discriminated against, by grounds of discrimination, sex and disability (%)
_meta.source: United Nations Statistics Division, Global SDG Indicators Database (data from national statistical offices / surveys, named per record)
_meta.licence: No dataset-specific licence found. UNdata terms: free of charge, may be copied freely if UNdata is cited (https://data.un.org/Host.aspx?Content=UNdataUse); un.org site terms are stricter (non-commercial). See README.
_meta.citation: United Nations Statistics Division, Global SDG Indicators Database, series VC_VOV_GDSD, accessed 2026-10-21.
notes: Surveys differ by country (age range, recall period, list of grounds); read footnotes per record. Values are not strictly comparable across countries.
Top-level value/year = latest all-grounds, both-sexes, all-ages total where published; otherwise null (no substitution).
Every API row appears twice (under 10.3.1 and 16.b.1); exact duplicates removed after verifying they are identical.
